name: Headline Battle
direction: Fictional newspaper front pages make the balances the headlines.
detail: Two enormous vintage newspaper front pages overlap diagonally in a lively collage. The left masthead is DAILY BUGLE, with a bold angular red headline panel below containing CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT. The right masthead is DAILY PLANET with a simple globe illustration beside the masthead, and an enormous cobalt headline panel containing CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT. Each headline has a cream interior and huge black/red or black/blue lettering. Beneath the headlines are beautiful ink illustrations of a New York skyline on the left and an optimistic art-deco Metropolis skyline on the right. Use geometric black line blocks for tiny text columns without actual words. Cream newspaper sheets, black shadows, red and yellow comic bursts behind them. They are full illustrated newspaper pages, not actual photos. NO people, faces, masks or superhero figures. Excellent collectible pop-art composition with huge readable numbers.
prompt:
Generate one finished landscape 4:3 COMIC-BOOK ARTWORK, designed to remain readable on a small 600x448 e-ink screen. This is a Marvel-versus-DC-inspired fan-art environment study with NO PEOPLE OR CHARACTER FIGURES. Beautiful bold black ink, bright cream paper, flat red, yellow, cobalt, green and orange accents, economical halftone and strong geometric forms. Scene fills the canvas, no physical device or desktop.
The huge data text must read exactly "CLAUDE", "20%", "WEEK LEFT" on the Marvel side, and "CODEX", "95%", "WEEK LEFT" on the DC side. The percentages mean weekly allowance remaining. No other numbers, progress bars, timestamps, prices, issue numbers, realistic newspaper body text or publisher logos. Integrate the exact data as prominent readable architectural/editorial lettering rather than a separate dashboard.

name: Twin Skylines
direction: Two comic city skylines carry giant illuminated allowance signs.
detail: A monumental panoramic comic-city diptych. On the left is a stylized optimistic Manhattan with a sleek Avengers-inspired high-rise, red and yellow sky, cream clouds and angular cobalt towers. On the right is an atmospheric but clearly readable Gotham skyline of gothic spires and art-deco skyscrapers against a cream sky with a big yellow moon; a simple black bat-shaped searchlight silhouette appears high in the sky. No people, faces or character figures anywhere. Two enormous illuminated CREAM BILLBOARDS mounted on the two dominant buildings are part of the architecture: CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT on the left, CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT on the right. Bold block lettering, flat graphic colours, powerful contrast, several sweeping architectural diagonals leading towards the signs. Broad white negative space, not a murky dark night image. The sky and rooftops visually connect the two comic universes. No other numerical values or tiny signs.
